comment: Each input is scaled to a tenth and shifted by half a volt before the equations, WS.cpp:57-61, then put twice through sin and cos terms, WS.cpp:73-81. The channel count is the smaller of the two inputs when both are patched, WS.cpp:46, so a monophonic cable in In2 makes the whole module monophonic. This is a port of the Sin WS module by Nozoid.
